meta.description: One place where every conversation becomes text and a written summary: calls made through any IP PBX, meetings held in Zoom, Teams or Meet, and recordings you already have and simply drop in. Windows, macOS and Linux. Your recordings and your AI can stay on your own machine. Free software under GPL v2.
dl.foot: You will need a SIP account — from your provider, or from the PBX you run yourself. Recording works the moment it is installed; the transcript and the write-up need either a service you choose or a model on your own machine.
footer.tagline: A desktop phone for Windows, macOS and Linux that records, transcribes and writes up every call. Free software under GPL v2.
